title: Debit card activation and deactivation - support procedure
content: For the demo, an agent checks the synthetic card status and explains its activation menu. Never provide a PIN, CVV or OTP to this assistant; it cannot activate or deactivate a real card. If the card has not arrived or its delivery status is unexpected, request a delivery review before attempting activation.
